ask_age: How old are you? You must be at least 18.
ask_age_max: What is the maximum age you are looking for?
ask_age_min: What is the minimum age you are looking for? (18 or older)
ask_age_range_invalid: Check the range: the minimum age must be 18 or older and the maximum must be equal to or greater than the minimum.
ask_bio: Write a short description of your personality (max 150 characters).
ask_city: What city do you live in? (optional, write - to skip)
ask_country: What country do you live in? (optional, write - to skip)
ask_display_name: What name do you want to show on your profile?
ask_gender: What gender do you identify with?
ask_interests: Write up to 3 interests, separated with commas.
ask_languages: What languages do you speak? Separate them with commas.
ask_platform_username: Choose your own CONECTA username (no spaces, at least 3 letters). It is not your Telegram @.
ask_platform_username_taken: That name is already taken. Choose another one.
ask_relationship: What kind of relationship are you looking for?
ask_seeking: What gender of people do you want to meet?
blocked_done: User blocked. Their profiles will no longer be shown and they cannot write to you.
chat_no_match: You can no longer write to this person (no match or blocked).
chat_photo_not_supported: In this MVP, chat supports text only. Photos in chat will come in a later phase.
chat_started: You are in the chat. Write your message. Use /salir to leave the chat.
daily_limit: You reached the free limit of 20 likes per day. Come back tomorrow.
delete_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete your account and profile?
discover_empty: There are no more compatible profiles for now. You can widen your age range with /registro or come back later.
error_generic: An error occurred. Please try again.
help_text:
CONECTA — Commands:
/start — start
/idioma — change language
/registro — create your profile
/descubrir — see profiles
/matches — your matches
/perfil — see your profile
/pausar — pause or activate your profile
/eliminar — delete your account
/premium — Premium information
/ayuda — this help
language_saved: Language saved. Use /registro to create your profile or /descubrir to see people. Commands work in any language.
match_other: You have a match! You can talk from /matches.
match_you: You have a match! You can talk from /matches.
paused_done: Your profile is paused. Use /pausar again to activate it.
premium_not_available: Premium is not available yet in this MVP. Nothing will be charged or unlocked yet.
preview_title: This is your profile. Review it before publishing:
profile_not_active: First create and publish your profile with /registro.
profile_published: Your profile is published. Use /descubrir to see people.
reg_start: Let's create your profile, one question at a time. You can write /ayuda at any time.
reported_done: Report sent. Thank you, we will review it.
